item.summary: fix(slack): route directory cursor pagination through the shared guard (#120445) listSlackDirectoryPeersLive/listSlackDirectoryGroupsLive hand-rolled do/while loops with no repeated-cursor detection and no page bound, while every other users.list/conversations.list consumer goes through collectSlackCursorPages. A Slack API or proxy edge that keeps returning the same non-empty next_cursor made directory queries paginate forever, growing the member/channel arrays without bound. Both loops now go through collectSlackCursorPages, which throws on a repeated cursor and caps total pages.
